english.title: Use on a road a wheeled vehicle and fail to ensure that a closet / urinal did not leak onto the road
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a wheeled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), having failed to ensure that every closet or urinal with which the vehicle was equipped did not leak onto the road
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 62 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a wheeled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), having failed to ensure that every closet or urinal with which the vehicle was equipped did not leak onto the road.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions
6 months
